team.abilityDesc: By floating in the air, the Pokémon receives full immunity to all Ground-type moves.

moves.name: Vine Whip
moves.desc: The target is struck with slender, whiplike vines to inflict damage.

moves.name: Leaf Tornado
moves.desc: The user attacks its target by encircling it in sharp leaves. This attack may also lower the target's accuracy.

moves.name: Crunch
moves.desc: The user crunches up the target with sharp fangs. This may also lower the target's Defense stat.

moves.name: Bite
moves.desc: The target is bitten with viciously sharp fangs. This may also make the target flinch.

team.abilityDesc: Boosts the Pokémon's evasiveness in a sandstorm.

moves.name: Energy Ball
moves.desc: The user draws power from nature and fires it at the target. This may also lower the target's Sp. Def stat.

moves.name: Absorb
moves.desc: A nutrient-draining attack. The user's HP is restored by over half the damage taken by the target.

moves.name: Feint Attack
moves.desc: The user approaches the target disarmingly, then throws a sucker punch. This attack never misses.

moves.name: Cotton Spore
moves.desc: The user releases cotton-like spores that cling to opposing Pokémon. This harshly lowers their Speed stats.

team.abilityDesc: Reduces the power of supereffective attacks that hit the Pokémon.

moves.name: Barrier
moves.desc: The user throws up a sturdy wall that sharply raises its Defense stat.

moves.name: Teeter Dance
moves.desc: The user performs a wobbly dance that confuses every Pokémon around it.

moves.name: Psychic
moves.desc: The target is hit with a strong telekinetic force to inflict damage. This may also lower the target's Sp. Def stat.

moves.name: Confusion
moves.desc: The target is hit with a weak telekinetic force to inflict damage. This may also confuse the target.
